metadata.$description: Dark-only, English-only, culturally grounded UI system blending Kerala diaspora identity with Naarm/Melbourne street-kr-dark aesthetics (screenprint + wheat-paste) and in-situ First Nations solidarity. No crowns, no bureaucracy motifs. Typography behaves as pressure/relief using variable axes and M3 Expressive motion.

motifs.$description: Motif system designed for icon-scale clarity and street-kr-dark screenprint aesthetic. No crowns. No bureaucratic forms, passports, IDs, border gates. First Nations solidarity appears only in situ (placards/posters), without aesthetic appropriation.
